prompt: Design a modular Microservices Feature Flag Management System in Python containing: (1) Evaluation Engine checking user context against segmentation rules, (2) Dynamic Configuration Sync service polling updates from a git repository, and (3) Audit Logging Subsystem tracking flag change histories.
evaluation_criteria:
Module 1 Engine Score: 0-5 (Evaluates rule evaluation speed and targeting logic)
Module 2 Sync Score: 0-5 (Evaluates background polling and thread safety)
Module 3 Audit Score: 0-5 (Evaluates change history serialization)
System Integration Score: 0-5 (Evaluates low-latency evaluation and fault tolerance)
